description: NaMoZnHO₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.73 Å. Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-54°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.83 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.28 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.70 Å) H-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mo, and two equivalent Zn atoms to form distorted ONaZn₂Mo trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONaZn₂H tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaZn₂Mo trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaZn₂H tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mo, and one Zn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Zn, and one H atom to form distorted ONaZn₂H tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaZn₂H tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONaZn₂Mo trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaZn₂Mo trigonal pyramid.
